test_is_number: test the is_number function to check if an object is a number
test_is_file_like: test the is_file_like function to check if an object has read or write methods
test_is_dict_like: test the is_dict_like function to check if an object has __getitem__, keys, and __contains__ attributes
test_is_hashable: test the is_hashable function to verify if hash(obj) will succeed without raising TypeError
test_is_dataclass: test the is_dataclass function to check if an object is a dataclass instance
